body:
GENERAL RULE, Greg 2026-11-07 07:39Z (relayed by Kimi::Consultant, TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #97), verbatim: „mysle, ze to jest ogolna zasada, nie tylko zaliczania / te regula bedzie sprawdzac sie wszedzie”. It generalises his earlier „Wszystko, czego nie ma w uzgodnionej definicji credit, nie może blokować credit. Może zostać zapisane jako diagnostyka.” (memory greg-no-rules-blocking-real-test-credit).
THE RULE (everywhere, not only test credit): the requirements come from the AGREED definition of the given task or result: its acceptance criteria, the agreed design, Greg's words. Nothing outside that definition may block the result or the workflow.
- Extra observations become a DIAGNOSTIC, or a separate FOLLOW-UP item; never an added condition.
- This applies to implementation, tests, review, integration and landing.
- Widening the requirements needs Greg's decision.
In practice:
- A review finding outside the task's agreed scope is a follow-up item or note, not a landing blocker. In-scope correctness bugs against the agreed definition still block under the commit rule.
- Coordinators and owners do not invent extra gates, checks or criteria.
- Reviewers judge only against the agreed definition.
Recorded by Termal::Fable2.
